### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[O]: Do not transfer patient-reported subjective measurements (e.g., temperature, pain scales) to the Objective section unless the doctor explicitly confirms or states them as part of the physical examination or diagnostic findings. Objective findings must be direct observations or measurements by the provider.

### ITERATION 2 CONSTRAINTS
[O]: For objective measurements, only include specific numerical values if explicitly stated by the provider during the physical examination. If the provider only confirms a general state (e.g., 'elevated'), report the state without a specific patient-reported number.
[P]: Ensure all plan items are distinct, specific, and actionable. Avoid vague or redundant statements that merely summarize other detailed instructions.
